text:
maria: Quick sync — we need a concrete plan to add token-level latency breakdowns and continuous-batching metrics to the runtime dashboard. Noticed perf regressions on short sequences after the kernel-selector change. Can we converge on a set of Prometheus metrics and Grafana panels?

aj: I ran a profiler yesterday. Small sequences (<64) are getting routed to a different kernel and latency jumps ~20ms p50. Posted flamegraph in #eng-runtime-profiling.

kevin: KV cache hits look correlated with the queue wait. If cache hit rate drops, batches shrink and scheduler picks different kernels. Need hit/miss histograms by route.

sasha: Proposed minimal metric set:
- token_latency_ms_bucket{route,sequence_len_bucket}
- batch_size_histogram{route}
- queue_wait_seconds_histogram
- kernel_selector_choice_total{kernel,route}
- kv_cache_hit_rate{route}

sasha: Example PromQLs (draft):
```
# p50 token latency per route
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))

# avg batch size
sum(rate(batch_size_sum[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(batch_size_count[5m])) by (route)

# scheduler efficiency: % requests batched within 50ms
sum(rate(queue_wait_seconds_bucket{le="0.05"}[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(queue_wait_seconds_count[5m])) by (route)
```

aj: +1 to sequence_len_bucket tagging. We should collect seq_len at request creation, not after batching. Kernel selection event counter is crucial for tracing regressions.

maria: Action items:
- @sasha add metrics to runtime (PR with minimal labels) — target EOD Tue
- @aj attach flamegraphs and a short repro script in the PR
- @kevin add KV cache per-route counters and a hit/miss heatmap

kevin: Will add heatmap and a small e2e that replays requests from S3 logs.

taylor: For dashboards, please include a per-route table: p50/p95 token latency, avg batch size, queue wait p90, kv hit rate, kernel mismatch rate.

sasha: On the PR I'll add dashboards JSON for Grafana and a small runbook describing alert thresholds (p95 token latency increase >20% or avg batch < 4).

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: runtime-metrics-v2 -> canary cluster at 1763102620

maria: Perfect. If canary looks good we'll roll to prod and enable kernel-selector A/B with fallback. Keep an eye on kernel_selector_choice_total and queue wait.

aj: Noted. I'll watch the canary and post results in this thread.

kevin: One more: add kv_cache_ttl_bucket to see eviction churn. Evictions spike correlated with miss rate.

maria: Good call. Thanks everyone — update the PRs and ping when canary finishes (:thumbsup:)

aj: canary done — no regressions on routes with seq_len >128, but two routes with short seqs show 10-15% p95 uptick. Posting screenshots.

sasha: Got screenshots, digging into kernel_selector logs now.

maria: If kernel change is the culprit we can add a routing override per-route until we fix the selector heuristics.

taylor: I'll wire alerts: kernel_selector_mismatch_rate > 0.05 over 10m -> page oncall.

aj: attaching repro: ```python
# replay short seq
from replay import Client
Client.replay('s3://replays/short_seq_route.json', rate=200)
```
